spans.s:
Rādhā
(‘one who propitiates’)
------------------------------------------
See under KṚṢṆA.
Some of the पुराणस् describe her as the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu and Kalāvatī and was the dearest companion of कृष्ण in गोकुल.
Karṇa’s foster-मोथेर् also was राधा, because of which he got the name ‘Rādheya’.
